_comment: HackRF only. Single-SDR mode covering control + voice in one window. Sample rate 9,984,000 = 24000 * 416. HackRF gain stages: amp (RF) accepts 0 or 14, IF (LNA) 0-40 in 8 dB steps, BB (VGA) 0-62 in 2 dB steps. Preamp ON for weak signals.

sources._comment: HackRF in single-SDR mode. Center between control + voice channels.

systems._comment_system: LRGVRRS control channels for nearest sites: Pharr (851.0675, 851.3375), McAllen (851.075, 851.3125, 852.9625). trunk-recorder will lock onto whichever decodes best.
